resources.string: Add to the Apps row on Home
The Home button and power-on lead to Mayo TV

Mayo TV then opens after power-on and comes back on the Home button. On boxes that keep their own start screen, the Home guard below takes care of the Home button. Without the guard you can switch the TV’s own start screen off once over adb: %1$s
Opens Mayo TV when the TV’s own start screen appears; Projectivy and Button Mapper stay on

The guard is an accessibility service. Mayo TV only adds itself to the list of switched-on services and never takes another one away. To switch it on from here, grant once over adb: %1$s — or switch it on yourself in the TV’s accessibility settings.
Home, Live TV or an app
Hold OK on an app in the row to move it
At the end of Home; each one on or off
Apps like Nuvio and TizenTube put rows on the TV’s start screen. Mayo TV shows them at the end of Home once Android lets it read them. If asking does not help, grant once over adb: %1$s
Opens Mayo TV when the TV’s own start screen comes to the front. It sees only which app is in front, nothing that is shown.
